summary: Fixed at the source the construction problem that made the previous end-to-end receipt's comparisons unknown. The harness now contains a single case whose events have unique names (nonauto_setup, nonauto_probe, nonauto_apply), so each comparison has one unambiguous admission, and the case is the same end-to-end flow: a real three-node network, the joint configuration entered and applied by every application with applied entries acknowledged so no conf change is pending unapplied, then an empty explicit-transition ConfChangeV2 proposed, shown in the log as an EntryConfChangeV2, committed, and applied the way the API requires. A local run records already_pending false, entry_type EntryConfChangeV2, committed_reached true and panicked true. The submission registers the experiment with a prerequisite on the cleared guard and three comparisons plus the two relevant facts as knowledge uses, so the controller's receipt should complete them; no interpretation is included because that receipt does not exist yet, and the earlier receipts, the asserted claim and its limitations are unchanged.
